question: Choose the correct one-word substitute for: 'Fear of public speaking.'
solution:
The correct answer is: **Glossophobia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Glossophobia"** refers to the fear of public speaking. (सार्वजनिक बोलने का डर)
 
 
• **Example:** Despite her preparation, her glossophobia prevented her from delivering the speech confidently.
 
 

 
• Fear of public speaking is a common phobia where individuals experience anxiety or nervousness when required to speak in front of an audience. (सार्वजनिक रूप से बोलने के समय घबराहट या चिंता)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Glossophobia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Sociophobia** (सामाजिक भय): The fear of social situations or interacting with people.
 
 
• **Example:** Her sociophobia made it difficult for her to attend parties or social gatherings.
 
 

 
• **Glossomania** (बोलने की अत्यधिक प्रवृत्ति): A strong desire or obsession to talk excessively.
 
 
• **Example:** His glossomania often made it hard for others to get a word in during conversations.
 
 

 
• **Misophobia** (गंदगी का डर): The fear of dirt, germs, or contamination.
 
 
• **Example:** Due to her misophobia, she constantly cleaned her hands even when they were not dirty.
